answer: Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 40% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned so that nobody profits from it. Because the dune forfeiture is applied at exit, the vine ledger totals each burn, and the terrace audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 106 aliases as a result destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 32 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
